Following the trail from bed to bed: Takijiri-oji → Chikatsuyu. Each move is that day's walk, with the bags sent ahead.

overview:
THIS TRIP

9 days in Tanzania, built around scenic viewpoints, history and culture and geology and geothermal.

WHERE YOU SLEEP
1
Ngorongoro Crater rim
8
nights

One base, Ngorongoro Crater rim: also sleeping in Arusha and Lake Manyara area would save about 2 h of travel a day over 6 days, but the moves would cost about 7 h 25 of packing up, checking in and travelling.

WHAT THIS PLAN STILL LACKS

Game drives in the parks: 2 of the 3 a trip like this needs. Add game drives in the parks on the Discovery Board; an operator-run circuit is the usual way.

SIGNATURE EXPERIENCES

The trip is built around
I · DAY 2
Naabi Hill viewpoint
A quick rock kopje climb at the Serengeti gate with sweeping plains views, worth the short stop.
II · DAY 3
Ngorongoro Crater floor safari
A self-contained ecosystem with dense wildlife including black rhino, best entered at dawn before other vehicles arrive.
III · DAY 4
Olduvai Gorge Museum
One of the world's key paleoanthropological sites, a short indoor stop on the way between Ngorongoro and Serengeti.

4 bases, Vík í Mýrdal, Höfn, Akureyri, Reykjavík: the moves cost about 20 h 30 in all. It takes these stays to follow the route. The hotel changes you allow cannot follow the whole route: Egilsstaðir is beyond a day's reach of where you stay.
